title: Platelet size–count coupling fails to improve cross-cycle prediction of combined grip strength
abstract: A registered interaction of log platelet count and log mean platelet volume was added to flexible conventional predictors including CBC indices and the systemic immune-inflammation index. Training used 4129 NHANES2011–12 adults; frozen evaluation used 4590 separately recruited NHANES2013–14 adults. Weighted MSE increased from 138.791709 to 138.793278 kg². The joint source–target survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval for baseline-minus-augmented MSE was [-0.564704,0.093126]. This representation provides no demonstrated incremental prediction. Independent-survey validation was not completed; temporal transfer within one survey cannot establish clinical utility or mechanism.
